content: Swift Charts builds an accessibility tree automatically and VoiceOver users get an Audio Graph + interactive Chart Detail page (double-tap-hold-drag) independent of chartXSelection; accessibilityChartDescriptor's summary is spoken on chart focus. chartXSelection is a separate, sighted-only drag gesture -- it does not by itself feed VoiceOver, so per-point values must be exposed via accessibilityChartDescriptor/AXChartDescriptor as a parallel path, not a replacement.
